title: Private Tour Montmorency Falls, Basilica & Orleans Island
blurb:
Start your half-day escape from Quebec City with a visit to the Albert Gilles Museum, where copper sheets come alive as breathtaking works of art. Next, step into the awe-inspiring Basilica of Sainte-Anne-de-Beaupré; explore freely or join a guided tour inside. Then, feel the power of Montmorency Falls up close before finishing on Île d'Orléans, where hidden gems, local flavors, and handcrafted chocolates await. 
Morning and afternoon departures available, with flexible pick-up and drop-off wherever suits you best. Book your spot today!
